fields.label: Applying based on program(s) or income

fields.label: Programs applicant or any household member is enrolled in
fields.condition: Program-based route; fill all applicable bubbles, including child participation. TANF/CalWORKs/StanWORKs/WTW/GAIN share one bubble.
options: Bureau of Indian Affairs General Assistance
fields.reuse_from_benefitscal: Q5 public assistance history is only a lead; Q7/15/18/22 may overlap. Confirm CURRENT enrollment; applying in BenefitsCal is not proof of enrollment.

fields.label: Copy of current qualifying-program participation proof
fields.condition: Program-based route requires proof with application.

fields.label: Number of adults 18 and over
fields.condition: Income-based Part B; count LifeLine economic household, not blindly all BenefitsCal residents.

fields.label: Number of children under 18
fields.condition: Income-based Part B; count LifeLine economic household, not blindly all BenefitsCal residents.

fields.label: Total household members
fields.condition: Income-based Part B; count LifeLine economic household, not blindly all BenefitsCal residents.
fields.reuse_from_benefitscal: Derive proposed count from Q6/6b after confirming LifeLine household boundaries.

fields.label: Household total annual gross income rounded to whole dollars
fields.condition: Income-based Part B; before taxes. Source income period/household definition requires confirmation.
fields.reuse_from_benefitscal: Q7–10 income records can assist calculation only after confirming time period, noncash income, and LifeLine economic household.

fields.label: Copy of household annual gross income proof
fields.condition: Income-based route requires proof with application.
options: Prior-year state/federal/tribal tax return front page only
Three consecutive months income statements/pay stubs within previous12 months
fields.source_locator: Registration Step1: acceptable income/program participation documents modal; also sample pp24–25
fields.reuse_from_benefitscal: Existing pay statements/tax return/benefits statements/support documents may be reused if their period, completeness, and household coverage satisfy LifeLine instructions.

fields.label: Do you live with another adult?
fields.condition: Everyone answering Other information; if No skip Q2/Q3 and initial B.

fields.label: Does the adult who lives with you receive a California LifeLine discount?

fields.label: Do you share income and living expenses with that adult?

fields.reuse_from_benefitscal: Q6 residents/Q21 food-preparation arrangement cannot answer LifeLine economic-unit question; ask explicitly.

fields.label: Certification A initials: address has more than one household

limitations: No account creation, authentication, signature, submission, real applicant data, or provider contact performed. No authenticated LifeLine form inspected.
Public sample PDF is paper_reference_not_live, not exact online schema; sample identifiers/addresses/dates are placeholders. A 26-page download supersedes stale indexed 16-page descriptions.

Public registration Step1 required asterisks observed by root agent; later steps blocked without real provider case. Other public FAQ statements obtained from official search-index extracts; no authenticated UI observed.

PIN is not a current Customer Portal login field: official portal help says email/password/MFA replaced PIN December15,2023. A provider-specific account PIN or historic mailed PIN is distinct and not cataloged as current requirement.
Version-specific conflicts: sample p23 >10-person income prose uses $8,500/$100,600 but its own 2026 table and CPUC annual page use $8,700 increment. No threshold calculations provided.
Sample p21 says one broadband OR phone benefit, while current official FAQ describes eligible bundled phone/broadband. Provider/pilot service configuration needs current confirmation.
Applicant SSN4 starred required on p15 but p21 permits complete tribal ID alternative; live branch not inspected. Do not impose universal SSN requirement from one label.

Current ID and eligibility-proof types observed in registration modals by root agent. Request-specific additional-proof forms, complete document-validity rules, upload size/file types, professional/provider APIs, and post-login screen order were not verified.

LifeLine household is economic unit; BenefitsCal residence or food-preparation household cannot automatically determine it. Pending BenefitsCal application is not proof of qualifying-program participation.
Required values describe source wording: explicit, conditional, not_marked, unknown. Explicit optional preferences are recorded in condition; not_marked never means mandatory.
California and federal Lifeline have separate processes per September17,2026 CPUC announcement; this catalog covers California, not federal National Verifier fields.
No eligibility advice: captured questions, evidence categories, and source boundaries only.
